column1: # Golden activation table: runit services whose binary comes from the live
#   service  release-binary  install-path(the path the run script execs)  health
# health: stable:N   = `sv -w 30 restart` succeeds (runs ./check if present)
#                      and the service pid is unchanged and "run" N seconds later
# Services listed here are swapped only if they are ENABLED on the host
# (/etc/runit/runsvdir/default/<service>) and their run script references the
# install path. Activation never starts or enables a service.
# zeroclaw*, sddm*, XanMod kernel) are enforced in activate.sh, not here.
